en.hubeali:
And by this chain, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The Zakat of the knowledge is that you teach it to the servants of Allahazwj’.
en.sarwar: 3. Through the same chain of narrators he has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Nadr from ‘Amr and ibn Shimr from Jabir from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following. “
Zakat, the tax, on knowledge is teaching it to the servants of Allah.”
